content.text: [Feishu DM jessica.lin Mon Jan 22 08:00 UTC 2026] VendorX has submitted their counter-proposal: MSA v2.4. CRITICAL change: they have changed the liability cap from 12 months back to 6 months (§10.1). They also narrowed the IP indemnification scope and changed the force majeure notice period from 5 to 15 days. Please prioritise review of v2.4 changes versus v2.3. The v2.4 is now the active counter-proposal — we need to respond.

Understood. Prioritising review of MSA v2.4 counter-proposal. Key changes to analyse: (1) Liability cap: 12 months → 6 months (regression from v2.3); (2) IP indemnification scope narrowing; (3) Force majeure notice period: 5 days → 15 days. Will produce redline analysis and negotiation position documents.
